_doc: Region id -> sigil fill pattern, for the MACRO territories only (metadata scale continental or regional); every other region is deliberately unpatterned. Generated from the repository root by tools/build-region-patterns.mjs, which writes every copy of the atlas data; gated by tools/pattern-adjacency-gate.mjs, which fails when two adjacent patterned regions share a pattern. Patterns come from apps/sigil, vendored as vendor/sigil-patterns.mjs.
